diagnostics.approximation: Robust Student-t MAP with IRLS Gaussian home-block covariance; historical strengths marginalized, not transferred.

inputs.cutoff_interpretation: Observed final status with kickoff cutoff; historical reconstruction is retrospective.

posterior.interpretation: Merit, raw rank and schedule strength use the saved marginal-quantile LOO approximation. Team strength and model parameters use the full-data posterior. Raw rank uses midranks for exact ties. Ordering rules are not applied to draws.
posterior.representation: Empirical mass or 40 equal-width bins spanning every saved draw; not a fitted density.

rank_interpretation: Policy order; uncertainty summaries describe raw earned merit separately.
scope: Completed regular-season FBS–FBS, FBS–FCS and FCS–FCS games in the joint model; FBS rankings and records include FCS games. FCS playoff games, bowls and CFP games are excluded.
uncertainty: Raw merit from paired marginal-quantile LOO transport; joint dependence is approximate.
